title: C¹ regularity and derivative of the Gram map x ↦ Dψ(x)*∘Dψ(x)
statement: For all n, N ∈ ℕ, every open V ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝᵈ := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) = Rn d) and every ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ that is C² on V: the Gram map G(x) := Dψ(x)* ∘ Dψ(x) ∈ L(ℝⁿ) (Dψ(x) := fderiv ℝ ψ x, L* := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint L) is C¹ on V, and for every x ∈ V and v ∈ ℝⁿ, DG(x)[v] = Dψ(x)* ∘ D²ψ(x)[v] + (D²ψ(x)[v])* ∘ Dψ(x), where DG(x) := fderiv ℝ G x and D²ψ(x)[v] := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x v ∈ L(ℝⁿ, ℝᴺ).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x ↦ ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) V ∧ ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ v : Rn n, fderiv ℝ (fun x ↦ ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) x v = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x v + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x v) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x
